# Maju LSK Logistics and Foodfare Sdn Bhd

> Maju LSK is the leading importer, distributor, and wholesale supplier of premium food ingredients in Brunei Darussalam, serving bakeries, HORECA (Hotel/Restaurant/Café), and retail supermarkets.

## About Us
Established as a trusted partner in the food and beverage industry, Maju LSK specializes in supplying high-quality bakery ingredients, frozen foods, beverages, and dairy products.

## Key Brands & Partnerships
We distribute over 500 products from more than 50 local and international agencies. Notable brands include:
- Ji-Mart Enterprise
- Syarikat Andong
- Genki!
- Kawan
- Callebaut
- Safcol
- Volvic
